def solution():
    current_prices = [150, 152, 151, 153, 155]
    prior_prices = [148, 149, 150, 151, 152]
    period1 = 25
    period2 = 13

    price_changes = [
        current - prior
        for current, prior in zip(current_prices, prior_prices)
    ]
    absolute_price_changes = [abs(change) for change in price_changes]

    def calculate_ema(values, period):
        multiplier = 2 / (period + 1)
        ema = values[0]
        for value in values[1:]:
            ema = (value - ema) * multiplier + ema
        return ema

    first_ema = [calculate_ema(price_changes[:i + 1], period1)
                 for i in range(len(price_changes))]
    absolute_first_ema = [
        calculate_ema(absolute_price_changes[:i + 1], period1)
        for i in range(len(absolute_price_changes))
    ]

    double_ema = calculate_ema(first_ema, period2)
    absolute_double_ema = calculate_ema(absolute_first_ema, period2)
    tsi = (double_ema / absolute_double_ema) * 100

    return round(tsi, 2)
